<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at 1.31.0 -->

## What's Changed
### New Features 🎉
* Allow inline usage of `st.chat_input` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/7896
* Feature: `st.page_link` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/7965
* Add `st.write_stream` command to handle generators or OpenAI output by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/7906
### Bug Fixes 🐛
* Reuse style element for theme injection into custom components by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/7914
* Handle out of order blocks when parsing element tree by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/7923
* Fix progress bar float input bug by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/7953
* Don't pass query parameters from parent page into iframes by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/7951
* Fix period type support for Pandas 2.2.0 by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/7988
* Only ignore hiding required columns in dynamic mode by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/7996
* Disable watchdog suggestion for `none` or `poll` watcher type by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8024
### Other Changes
* Support latest importlib-metadata v7 by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/7925
* Make Snowpark dependency truly optional for SnowflakeConnection by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/7919

## New Contributors
* [USER] made their first contribution in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/7914
* [USER] made their first contribution in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/7925
* [USER] made their first contribution in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/7953
